about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm a software developer and founder working across software, hardware, and product development. I also compete in fencing, which led directly to JustIn. I saw a problem in a sport I know deeply and decided to build the technology I wanted to exist.
I enjoy taking ambiguous problems, building complete systems, testing them with real people, and using what I learn to build the next version.
